  groupadd --system inventorysvc

if ! getent passwd inventorysvc >/dev/null; then
  useradd --system --gid inventorysvc --home-dir /var/lib/inventorysvc --create-home --shell /sbin/nologin inventorysvc

install -d -o inventorysvc -g inventorysvc -m 0750 /var/lib/inventorysvc
id inventorysvc
getent passwd inventorysvc

[Unit]

WorkingDirectory=/var/lib/inventorysvc
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5s
NoNewPrivileges=true
